title: Quest City Stage / Session Orchestration Contract
description: Canonical, runtime-independent contract for the orchestration layer decided in R3C.2A (GUIDED_PRACTICE_IS_ORCHESTRATION_LAYER, 02_36 section 20-bis). Formalizes R3C2_ORCHESTRATION_CONTRACT_FOLLOWUP (02_36 section 20-bis.11). Distinguishes SequenceDefinition (authored content/config, immutable per version) from SequenceRuntimeState (mutable per-run state). Does not duplicate schemas/engine-registry.schema.json, schemas/support-evaluation.schema.json, schemas/reusable-learning-engine.schema.json, or the attemptState/completionStatus model of 02_26 section 18.6 -- SequenceRuntimeState references existing attempts by id and never re-declares their status. The orchestration layer never owns validator logic: correctness of any interactive stage always comes from the Learning Engine resolved for that stage via the existing Engine Registry / Support Evaluator (02_36 sections 5 and 8), referenced here, never re-implemented.

sequenceId.description: Runtime-independent identity of the authored sequence (e.g. a lesson/vertical-slice package). Not a canonicalEngineId or runtimeAdapterId -- this is not an engine.

stageType.description: Runtime/subject-agnostic free-form identifier -- deliberately not a closed enum, since stage vocabularies differ by subject and runtime. Known Web M06 values (07_13 section 4) shown as examples only, not exhaustive: INTRO_HOOK, PREREQUISITE_CHECK, MICRO_LESSON, QUICK_QUESTION_SET, GUIDED_PRACTICE, INTERACTIVE_EXERCISE, BALANCE_MACHINE_CHALLENGE, REFLECTION_AND_RESULT.

isInteractive.description: false for presentation-only stages (e.g. INTRO_HOOK, REFLECTION_AND_RESULT) that dispatch to no Learning Engine.

activityRef.description: Reference to an existing ActivityDefinition/content entry (07_08 section 4). Required when isInteractive is true.

EngineDispatchRef.description: Never resolves an engine itself -- both modes delegate to the existing Engine Registry / Support Evaluator (02_36 sections 5 and 8). An unknown/unresolvable reference is never silently treated as ENGINE_GAP or dispatched to a similar engine (consistent with the R3C.1 attempt-dispatch precedent).

resolutionMode.description: RUNTIME_ADAPTER_ID: direct reference to an existing Engine Registry runtimeAdapterId. SUPPORT_EVALUATOR: resolved at runtime via the existing Support Evaluator from requiredCapabilities.

HintPolicy.description: Governs hintLevel/hintCount gating only. Hint content itself is never embedded here -- it remains content/bundle-owned and is presented by the Learning Engine of the active stage in response to the existing REQUEST_HINT semantic action (02_36 section 7), which this contract reuses unchanged.

runtimeStateId.description: Opaque identifier for this runtime state instance. Persistence ownership (which store, which key) is deliberately out of scope of this contract -- registered as a Web-implementation follow-up, not decided here (persistence-independent by design).

sequenceId.description: Must match a SequenceDefinition.sequenceId. This contract does not itself enforce that cross-document reference -- see the fixture test suite for semantic (non-schema) verification of this constraint.

sequenceCompletionState.description: Aggregate completion of the whole sequence, owned exclusively by the orchestration layer. Distinct by design from attemptState/completionStatus (02_26 section 18.6), which remain owned per-stage by the dispatched Learning Engine's own attempt. Never assigned to, or read from, a single attempt -- not an 'orchestrationAttemptState' or a competing lifecycle.

lastTransitionEvent.description: Internal orchestration-layer event vocabulary. Distinct from and never merged with the shared SemanticAction vocabulary (02_36 section 7 / 07_08 section 6) -- these events are never dispatched to a Learning Engine and never appear as a SemanticAction.actionType. In particular, STAGE_ADVANCED is the internal event that replaces the never-canonical ADVANCE_STAGE value removed from 07_13 section 10 in R3C.2A.

attemptId.description: Reference only -- the attempt's own attemptState/completionStatus (02_26 section 18.6) remains the sole authority for that attempt's status. This contract never re-declares or duplicates it.
